Anya: quick check-in on our 'soft-lease' contract manager idea. short leases, decay scoring, cheap warm tokens.
Micah: love a lightweight path vs full reservations. what are TTL bounds?
Anya: proposal: 30s min, 300s max. server clamps and enforces tenant_quota.
Lia: renewal abuse?
Micah: renewal_quota window + exponential backoff + renewal_count influences score (lower if churny).
James: operator split?
Anya: sidecar contract-manager publishes intents; placement controller consumes. leader election via existing operator lock.
Lia: metrics/alerts: renewal_rate, churn_flag_rate, placement_mismatch >1% alert, revoke_rate.
James: billing: free N renewals/month then small metered charge. I'll draft.
orch-bot: ci -> contract-manager:canary built, tests passed. logs: https://ci/redwood/ccm/987 :white_check_mark:
Micah: i'll sketch an RFC and prototype the score function. Lia: i'll write the runbook. James: pricing follow-up. Anya: thanks, tag me on RFC. :rocket:
